name: tick-meter
title: Tick Meter 刻度仪表
description: 独立原创的六十条径向 SVG 刻度仪表，保留原始超限读数。

whenToUse: 需要无动效的只读径向配额刻度和原始超限读数

whenNotToUse.case: 需要连续弧线而不是离散刻度

accessibility: 调用方提供 label 和原样保留的 valueText；图形与 aria-valuenow 限制在 0–100
responsive: 正方形 SVG 随容器缩放，不使用圆形 CSS mask

files.content:
# Independent Provenance

TickMeter was authored for Valar on 2026-11-07 solely from the product requirements:

- Read-only percentage graphic, visually bounded to 0–100.
- Preserve raw overflow in visible number and caller-localized valueText; clamp aria-valuenow to 0–100 per the clarified integration requirement on 2026-11-07. Accept caller-localized label.
- Accent/danger tones using Valar primary/destructive tokens.
- Exactly 60 radial SVG line elements, calculated at six-degree intervals.
- No celebration, animation, circular CSS mask or missing-value state (caller handles missing).

No Arc Pro tick-ring implementation, CSS, assets or source-derived geometry was read, copied or translated. This is not a port of Arc Activity Rings. Valar's repository MIT license applies; no Arc Pro license or source is included in this component.

# Tick Meter Design Rules

- Independently authored SVG meter, not a redistributed Arc Pro component. Keep PROVENANCE.md with source.
- Exactly 60 radial lines; filled count and aria-valuenow clamp to 0–100. Visible number retains raw overflow; valueText is preserved exactly as the localized spoken explanation.
- Caller supplies finite value, label and valueText and handles missing data before mounting. Never turn missing into 0.
- Accent maps to primary, danger to destructive. Keep the display read-only, without celebration, animation or circular CSS masks.
